description: The tree a receipt is bound to and the completion judged against the final tree (plan task pod-18, docs/PROOF-RECEIPTS.md) in lib/agent-autonomy.mjs: verifyHostEvidence (a check whose trees differ is no receipt, an overlapped or tree-less call is unknown, an edit on the tree after it, a read on the current tree), assessCompletionEvidence (fresh / unknown / stale / missing per kind, the words, the final tree given), classifyTaskCompletion, the evidence report the model reads and the recovery text; judged by tests/verify-agent-autonomy.mjs.

mutations.name: AA-steady-overlapped
mutations.what: a call beside another one is bound to its tree

mutations.name: AA-steady-no-before
mutations.what: a call without a tree before it is bound to the tree after it

mutations.name: AA-read-current-with-trees
mutations.what: a read with trees of its own is bound to the current tree

mutations.name: AA-read-unbound
mutations.what: a read without trees is not bound to the current tree

mutations.name: AA-edit-overlapped
mutations.what: an edit beside another call is bound to the tree after it

mutations.name: AA-edit-current
mutations.what: an edit without trees is bound to the tree before it

mutations.name: AA-check-changed-kept
mutations.what: a check that changed the files it checked is a receipt

mutations.name: AA-check-current
mutations.what: a check without trees is bound to the tree before it

mutations.name: AA-assess-unknown-fresh
mutations.what: a receipt of unknown freshness counts

mutations.name: AA-assess-stale-first
mutations.what: stale is said before unknown for a kind

mutations.name: AA-assess-tree-ignored
mutations.what: the final tree given is ignored

mutations.name: AA-freshness-order
mutations.what: the whole judgment says stale before unknown

mutations.name: AA-missing-no-reason
mutations.what: what is missing does not say stale or unknown

mutations.name: AA-classify-tree-dropped
mutations.what: the completion ignores the final tree given

mutations.name: AA-report-ids
mutations.what: the evidence report the model reads carries receipt ids (and their tree prefix)

mutations.name: AA-recovery-raw
mutations.what: the recovery text reads the raw progress
